critical_runtime_risks.title: Global exception suppression can mask fatal corruption
critical_runtime_risks.impact: Process remains alive after potentially unrecoverable state divergence; can continue charging/executing with inconsistent state.

critical_runtime_risks.title: Unbounded background loops without durable checkpoints
critical_runtime_risks.impact: Duplicate work, replay risk on restart, and missed work during downtime.

critical_runtime_risks.title: Mixed orchestration layers with no single source of truth
critical_runtime_risks.impact: Orphan runs, conflicting execution semantics, race conditions.

hidden_retry_loops: signalBilling.flushBuffer requeues failed batches in-memory without bounded retry horizon.
task engine + watchdog strategy can retry same logical task through multiple code paths.
orphan_patterns: Legacy scripts in scripts/ and core/ with production-like side effects but no central scheduler registration.
Multiple server entry scripts likely deployed independently over time.
